## Learning Objectives

By the end of this lecture, you will be able to:

- Understand the [fundamental concepts]{style="color: tomato;"} of [model fitting]{style="color: tomato;"} and [calibration]{style="color: tomato;"}
- Apply [least squares estimation]{style="color: tomato;"} to [compartmental models]{style="color: tomato;"}
- Implement [maximum likelihood estimation]{style="color: tomato;"} for [epidemic models]{style="color: tomato;"}
- Compare the [strengths and weaknesses]{style="color: tomato;"} of different [fitting methods]{style="color: tomato;"}
- Recognize when to use [advanced methods]{style="color: tomato;"} like [MCMC]{style="color: tomato;"} and [particle filtering]{style="color: tomato;"}
- [Troubleshoot]{style="color: tomato;"} common [fitting problems]{style="color: tomato;"}
